import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long mo;
    static class ModInt {
        long v;
        ModInt() {
            this.v=0;
        }
        ModInt(long a) {
            this.v=a;
            if (mo !=0 && (v >= mo || v<0)) {
                v = ((v % mo) + mo) % mo;
            }
        }
        static ModInt pow(ModInt a, long n) {
            long b = a.v;
            long r = 1;
            while (n !=0) {
                if ((n & 1) != 0) {
                    r = r * b % mo;
                }
                b = (b * b) % mo;
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return new ModInt(r);
        }
        ModInt add(ModInt a) {
            long res = this.v + a.v;
            if (mo != 0 && res >= mo) res -= mo;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        ModInt sub(ModInt a) {
            long res = this.v - a.v;
            if (mo != 0 && res <0) res += mo;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        ModInt mul(ModInt a) {
            return new ModInt(this.v * a.v % mo);
        }
        ModInt div(ModInt a) {
            return this.mul(pow(a, mo - 2));
        }
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(v);
        }
    }
    
    static int N, M;
    static ModInt[] dp1 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[] dp2 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[][] dp3 = new ModInt[505][505];
    static ModInt[][] dp4 = new ModInt[505][505];

    static long comb(int N_, int C_) {
        final int NUM_ = 400001;
        static long[] fact = new long[NUM_ +1];
        static long[] factr = new long[NUM_ +1];
        static long[] inv = new long[NUM_ +1];
        if (fact[0] == 0) {
            inv[1] = 1;
            fact[0] = 1;
            factr[0] = 1;
            for (int i=2;i<=NUM_;++i) inv[i] = inv[(int)(mo % i)] * (mo - mo / i) % mo;
            for (int i=1;i<=NUM_;++i) {
                fact[i] = fact[i-1]*i % mo;
                factr[i] = factr[i-1]*inv[i]%mo;
            }
        }
        if (C_<0 || C_>N_) return 0;
        return factr[C_]*fact[N_]%mo*factr[N_-C_] % mo;
    }
    
    static void init() {
        for (int i=0;i<=504;i++) {
            dp1[i]=new ModInt(0);
            dp2[i]=new ModInt(0);
            for (int j=0;j<=504;j++) {
                dp3[i][j]=new ModInt(0);
                dp4[i][j]=new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;
        String line = br.readLine();
        st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mo = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        
        init();

        dp1[0]=new ModInt(1);
        for (int i=1;i<=N;i++) {
            for (int j=1;j<=i;j++) {
                long c = comb(i-1,j-1);
                ModInt term1 = new ModInt(i+1).mul(dp1[j-1]).mul(dp1[i-j]).mul(new ModInt(c));
                dp1[i] = dp1[i].add(term1);
                
                ModInt term2_part1 = dp2[i - j].mul(dp1[j-1]);
                ModInt term2_part2 = dp1[i-j].mul(dp2[j-1]);
                ModInt sum_terms = term2_part1.add(term2_part2).mul(new ModInt(c));
                dp2[i]=dp2[i].add(new ModInt(i+1).mul(sum_terms));
                
                ModInt term3 = dp1[j-1].mul(dp1[i-j]).mul(new ModInt(c)).mul(
                        new ModInt(1).add(
                                new ModInt(j).mul(j+1).div(new ModInt(2))
                        ).add(
                                new ModInt(i - j).mul(i - j + 1).div(new ModInt(2))
                        )
                ));
                dp2[i]=dp2[i].add(term3);
            }
        }

        for (int i=0;i<=N;i++) {
            for (int j=0;j<=i;j++) {
                if (i==0 && j==0) {
                    dp3[i][j]=new ModInt(1);
                    dp4[i][j]=new ModInt(1);
                } else {
                    dp3[i][j]=dp3[i-1][j];
                    dp4[i][j]=dp4[i-1][j];
                    for (int l=1;l<=j;l++) {
                        long c = comb(j, l);
                        dp3[i][j]=dp3[i][j].add(dp1[l].mul(dp3[i - l - 1][j - l]).mul(new ModInt(c)));
                        dp4[i][j]=dp4[i][j].add(
                                (dp1[l].mul(dp4[i - l - 1][j - l]).add(dp2[l].mul(dp3[i - l - 1][j - l]))).mul(new ModInt(c))
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i]=dp1[i];
            dp4[i][i]=dp2[i];
        }

        System.out.println(dp4[N][M]);
    }
}
